name: GTG-87001
akas: UnSub (Anthropic designation); northern-Yemen-based weapons engineering cell — *analyst note: secondary press (The Register, Politico) labeled this "Houthi"; Anthropic's own report never uses that word — the Houthi attribution is unconfirmed by the primary source and not repeated as fact here.*
brief: Anthropic disrupted a northern-Yemen-based cell running three parallel AI-assisted weapons-development programs: a guided rocket using a commodity phone-class flight computer with terminal-phase homing guidance; a multi-stage ballistic missile with a stated range goal above 2,000 km; and a multi-variant missile family ("R2000") including a hypersonic glide-vehicle variant. The actors ran Claude Code "in place of human software engineers" for guidance/navigation/control (GNC) software, delegating coder/researcher/reviewer roles across multiple Claude instances and splitting work across sessions to evade safeguards. Anthropic found no evidence of a fielded operational device, but the actors test-fired a guided rocket; the field test appears to have failed, and the actors returned to Claude within hours to diagnose the failure. Anthropic
